en.plugins.eval.desc: Run JavaScript code (owner only, private chat, dangerous)
en.plugins.eval.usage:
*⚠️ JavaScript executor*

*Usage:* {0}eval <code>

*Examples:*
{0}eval return 2 + 2
{0}eval return process.version
{0}eval return Object.keys(message)

*Warning:* this runs ANY code with the bot's privileges. Secrets from the configuration are hidden in the output.
